packages.title: Voice copy: a privacy line that fits; no 'type' on Voz
brief: Context: b6 round 2 ran P81. The reviewer (verify-b6-r2-A) found U9 fixed in code, and UX-491 and UX-492 each partly fixed (second attempt for both; one more failure escalates them). Keep everything P81 did; this package changes two strings' worth of behaviour only.

UX-491 (R1A-1, S2) — what P81 did: the first-capture note in the sheet is now one `Text(l10n.capturePrivacyLine, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)` in bodySmall / onSurfaceVariant under the words (voice_task_screen.dart:1674-1688, key `capture-privacy`), and the words have their full height again. Why it failed: the copy is too long. In App/build/capture-listening-es-2x.png, at 2× text in Spanish on 360 dp, line 2 ends `palabras por internet para…`, so the newcomer never sees `convertirlas en tareas. Más en Ajustes.` — the line's only pointer to the details — and the note shows once per device. P81's implementer reported the same.

Fix: shorten `capturePrivacyLine` in place (only the sheet uses it): EN `Your words go online. More in Settings.` / ES `Tus palabras van por internet. Más en Ajustes.` / CA `Les paraules van per internet. Més a Configuració.` (Copy from the reviewer; `Ajustes` / `Configuració` match the `settings` key in each catalog.) Keep maxLines 2 and the ellipsis. Then check with a quick throwaway widget test, or by rendering, that at 2× text on 360×740 the line fits in 2 lines in both Spanish and Catalan (`tester.renderObject<RenderParagraph>(...).didExceedMaxLines` is false). If either language still exceeds 2 lines, change `maxLines` to 3 for all languages; don't shorten the copy further and don't drop the ellipsis. Say in your notes which value you kept and why.

Update the existing test that pins the old string (voice_settings_test.dart:363-367, `expect(es.capturePrivacyLine, 'TaskFlow envía tus palabras…')`) to the new Spanish copy. Don't change when the note shows (`_showPrivacyOnce`, first microphone use only), its key, its style or its place.

UX-492 (R1A-2, S2) — what P81 did: Voz has the `speechMethod` heading, plain option labels, a reworded `onDeviceUnavailable`, and the Voz-only `voiceSetupRequested` at voice_settings_screen.dart:77. Why it failed: when Android's speech set-up can't open (`prepareLanguage` returns false or throws, `_setUp`, :66-80), Voz still shows `captureSetupUnavailable` (:78), which tells the user to use saved audio or type: ES `…Usa audio guardado o escribe.` / EN `…Use saved audio or type.` / CA `…Utilitza àudio desat o escriu.` Voz has nothing to record or type. The test fake's `prepareLanguage` always returns true (voice_settings_test.dart:790), so the branch was never exercised.

Fix: add a Voz-only key `voiceSetupUnavailable` next to `voiceSetupRequested` in all three ARB files, and use it at voice_settings_screen.dart:78 instead of `captureSetupUnavailable`: EN `This phone can’t set this up, so TaskFlow does it online.` / ES `Este teléfono no puede configurarlo, así que TaskFlow lo hace en línea.` / CA `Aquest telèfon no ho pot configurar, així que TaskFlow ho fa en línia.` Use the typographic apostrophe (’) in English, as the catalog does. Leave `captureSetupUnavailable` untouched: the capture sheet still uses it (App/lib/l10n/capture_messages.dart:34).

To let tests reach that branch, make the test fake's result settable (e.g. a `bool prepares = true` field on `_Speech` in voice_settings_test.dart, returned by `prepareLanguage`). Keep the default true so the existing tests behave as before.

Run `flutter gen-l10n` after the ARB edits, then re-run `flutter test --no-pub --dart-define=WRITE_REVIEW_PREVIEWS=true test/review_tasks_test.dart` so App/build/capture-listening-es-2x.png shows the new line.

Don't touch: the `capturePrivacy` paragraph on Voz, the Voz language rows, `onDeviceUnavailable`, `voiceSetupRequested`, `setUpSpeech`, `checkAgain`, the capture sheet's `captureSetup*` keys, the hint under the note, NativeSpeechBridge.kt, the `language` sent with drafts (UX-493, P82), and anything about free dictations.
acceptance: Widget test: on the first capture, in Spanish at 2× text on 360×740 while listening, the line keyed `capture-privacy` reads `Tus palabras van por internet. Más en Ajustes.` and its text is laid out whole, without hitting its max lines (RenderParagraph.didExceedMaxLines is false).
Widget test: the same in Catalan at 2× text on 360×740: the line reads `Les paraules van per internet. Més a Configuració.` and didExceedMaxLines is false.

Widget test: in Spanish at 2× text on 360×740, with the privacy line showing and enough dictated words to fill the area, the newest words are visible and nothing overflows (the existing UX-491 check still passes).
Render: in App/build/capture-listening-es-2x.png the note ends with `Más en Ajustes.` and no line is cut or ends in `…`.

Widget test: on Ajustes › Otros ajustes › Voz in Spanish, with on-device speech lacking the language and `prepareLanguage` returning false, tapping `Configurar la transcripción local` shows `Este teléfono no puede configurarlo, así que TaskFlow lo hace en línea.`; no text on Voz contains `escribe`, `audio guardado`, `Graba` or `escribiendo`.
Widget test: the same with `prepareLanguage` throwing shows the same message.
Widget test: on Voz with `prepareLanguage` returning true, the banner still reads `Sigue los pasos de Android y luego pulsa Comprobar de nuevo.`
Widget test: Voz in Catalan at 2× text on 320×640, after a failed set-up, shows `Aquest telèfon no ho pot configurar, així que TaskFlow ho fa en línia.` without overflow.
Code: `captureSetupUnavailable` is used only by capture_messages.dart; `voiceSetupUnavailable` only by voice_settings_screen.dart; `capturePrivacy` only by voice_settings_screen.dart.
deviceChecks: First capture after a fresh install, phone in Spanish at large text: one short line under the words while speaking, ending `Más en Ajustes.`, nothing cut.

packages.title: Sign-in: one 'Forgot password?' control, not two
brief: UX-495 (R2D-1, S1) is a regression from P83 (b6 round 2); P83's brief told the implementer to leave the small link alone, so this is a follow-up to that brief. P83 added an OutlinedButton keyed `recover-with-email` with the `forgotPassword` label (`¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?`), shown below the error when sign-in was reached through `Iniciar sesión con este correo` and fails with wrong credentials (`unknownAccount && _accountExists`, login_screen.dart:613-625). In that state the small TextButton with the same label still shows above `account-submit` (login_screen.dart:549-561, condition `if (!_recover && !_register)`). Two controls with the same name and action sit a few dp apart, and TalkBack reads the name twice.

Fix (subtract): hide the small link while the recovery button shows. Change its condition to `!_recover && !_register && !(unknownAccount && _accountExists)`. `unknownAccount` is already in scope (computed in build at :257). Keep the existing `else const SizedBox(height: 20)` so the spacing above the submit button stays the same when the link is hidden. No new copy, no ARB change.

Extend the existing UX-488 round-trip test in auth_gate_test.dart (the Spanish 2× test near :757): in the wrong-credentials state, `find.text('¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?')` finds exactly one widget, inside the `recover-with-email` button.

Don't touch: the `recover-with-email` and `create-account-with-email` buttons, `_accountExists` handling, the `sign-in-with-email` button, the password validators (UX-484), error texts, headings, Google sign-in.
acceptance: Widget test, Spanish, 2× text on 360×740: create mode → email in use → `Iniciar sesión con este correo` → submit → wrong credentials: `¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?` appears exactly once, as the `recover-with-email` button.
Widget test: a direct sign-in with wrong credentials (not through the email-in-use button) still shows the small `¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?` link once, and `Crear una cuenta con este correo`.
Widget test: plain sign-in mode with no error still shows the small `¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?` link.

skipped.reason: Not re-planned. The app half is done in code (P82: CaptureSession.language, CaptureStore.create, the sheet passes it for spoken captures only, capture_processor.dart:160 sends it with ai/drafts/). What remains is cause server-side: Backend/core/serializers.py (drafts serializer, near :295) must accept an optional `language`, and Backend/core/ai.py `transcribe` / `_transcribe_once` (:88, :108-112) must tell the model the chosen language. The implementer can't change Backend/; this is for the main session. Stays open in ISSUES.md; not counted as a second failure and not escalated.
